title: Baton: one orchestrator for Claude Code, Codex and API models
excerpt: Routing tasks between Claude Code, Codex and API models with shared context, through plan, validate, code, test and integrate stages.

metrics.label: Claude Code, Codex and OpenRouter models

content:
01 · Discover

The problem

Coding agents are fast, but left alone they skip planning, review and tests. Teams end up babysitting each run instead of shipping.

02 · Architect

One job, five stages

Baton (the jev CLI plus a web dashboard) treats every idea as a job that moves through plan, validate, code, test and integrate. Each stage is dispatched to the provider best suited to it, with cost-aware routing and a quality gate before anything merges.

03 · Build

What it does

  • Autonomy modes from fully supervised to hands-off
  • Idea queue, scheduler, Kanban board and a fleet view across runs
  • Per-role MCP tools and skills, and learning profiles that improve routing over time
  • Browser preview with human takeover

04 · Launch

Open source

Work arrives as reviewed, tested pull requests instead of raw diffs. The orchestrator is public on GitHub.
